worth_reading.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Ultrafast now available on AI Gateway
worth_reading.author: Vercel AI
worth_reading.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Ultrafast is now available on AI Gateway through Fireworks. This model can generate upwards of 1,000 tokens per second . Ultrafast serves the October 17 update of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash through Fireworks' accelerated serverless endpoint. It is suited to interactive coding, reasoning, and agentic workflows where applications need to generate output and move to the next step quickly. The model has a 1M-token context window for working with large codebases
